# Tech Fusion Club (TFC) — Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU)

> The official premier student-led technical club at Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU), Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## About Tech Fusion Club (TFC)
Tech Fusion Club (TFC) is the benchmark student engineering society of Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU). Founded in 2019 under the mentorship of Er. Abhishek Kumar Saxena (Assistant Director, IQAC & Head Technical Society, SRMU), TFC trains students in real-world software engineering, hosts national hackathons, and organizes university technical events.

## University Affiliation
- **Institution**: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial University (SRMU)
- **Location**: Deva Road, Village Hadaha, Post Daryabad, Lucknow / Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh 225003, India
- **Official University Portal**: https://srmu.ac.in
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 26.9745, Longitude 81.1072

## Flagship Annual Tech Fest: Viveka
- **Event Name**: Viveka (The Intelligence)
- **Organizer**: Tech Fusion Club (TFC) SRMU
- **Description**: The largest annual national technical festival of SRMU, featuring 36-hour hackathons, algorithmic coding competitions (Codex), project expos, cybersecurity CTFs, and tech keynote speeches from industry leaders.
- **Official Fest Portal**: https://vivekatheintelligence.in/

## Core Engineering Domains
1. **Web Development**: Full-stack web applications, React, TypeScript, Node.js, modern backend architectures.
2. **AI & Machine Learning**: Deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, LLM integrations, PyTorch.
3. **Cybersecurity**: Defensive engineering, penetration testing, CTF challenges, cryptography, network security.
4. **App Development**: Cross-platform mobile development (Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Firebase).
5. **Cloud & DevOps**: Linux, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, AWS and Terraform.
6. **UI/UX & Creative Media**: Product design systems, visual identities, Figma prototypes, stage and digital media.

## Club Statistics
- **Founded**: 2019
- **Active Builders**: 320+ students
- **Events & Bootcamps**: 500+
- **Workshops Conducted**: 800+
